# Backdrop (`backdrop`)

The canvas gradient and ambient glow behind screens; off in calm themes.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBackdrop` (types in `dist/web/foundations/backdrop.d.ts`): `.mh-backdrop` (`--fixed`, `--drift`, `--dim`): the canvas behind a screen, a decorative layer painted from the theme's `--mh-backdrop`: gradient and ambient glow, or the flat canvas when the theme turns its backdrop off. Put it first inside a `.mh-backdrop-host` (or make it `fixed`); the host's content stays above it.

```ts
export function createBackdrop(options: BackdropOptions = {}): BackdropHandle;

export interface BackdropOptions {
  /** Cover the viewport (`position: fixed`) instead of the nearest `.mh-backdrop-host`. */
  fixed?: boolean;
  /** Let the ambient glow drift slowly. Still with reduced motion, and invisible in calm themes (no glow). */
  drift?: boolean;
  /** Lay the theme's scrim over the canvas, e.g. behind a screensaver clock. */
  dim?: boolean;
}

export interface BackdropHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setDrift(drift: boolean): void;
  setDim(dim: boolean): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBackdrop, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Content inside a .mh-backdrop-host stays above the backdrop.
const screen = document.createElement('main');
screen.className = 'mh-backdrop-host';

const backdrop = createBackdrop({ drift: true });
screen.append(backdrop.el, createText('22:40', { variant: 'display' }));

// Dim the canvas while the screen is idle; a touch brightens it again.
const IDLE_MS = 30_000;
let idle = setTimeout(() => backdrop.setDim(true), IDLE_MS);
screen.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
  backdrop.setDim(false);
  clearTimeout(idle);
  idle = setTimeout(() => backdrop.setDim(true), IDLE_MS);
});

document.body.append(screen);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Backdrop, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const IDLE_MS = 30_000;

export function BackdropExample() {
  const [idle, setIdle] = useState(false);
  const [touches, setTouches] = useState(0);
  // Dim the canvas once the screen has been left alone; each touch restarts the wait.
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setIdle(true), IDLE_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [touches]);
  const wake = () => {
    setIdle(false);
    setTouches((n) => n + 1);
  };
  return (
    // Content inside a .mh-backdrop-host stays above the backdrop.
    <main className="mh-backdrop-host" onPointerDown={wake}>
      <Backdrop drift dim={idle} />
      <Text variant="display">22:40</Text>
    </main>
  );
}
```
